test_results: 190 passed (phase2_rule_pool + island scheduler), 18 passed (migration safety), all passing
summary: Migration semantics: updated log and config comments to accurately describe sequential post-cluster chain migration (cluster N -> N+1 after cluster N finishes), removed misleading 'interval=N' epoch language, annotated _should_migrate_this_round as legacy. Train/val seed distinctness: added _derive_val_sample_seed() helper with prime offset; Rule_Pool_Generator now stores and uses _val_sample_seed for validation sampling. All existing deterministic sampling behavior preserved. 7 new tests added for seed distinctness, determinism, and generator integration.
notes: PHASE2_MIGRATION_EPOCH_INTERVAL retained as no-op legacy config for backward compatibility. The sequential chain migration does not use epoch-interval gating; migration fires unconditionally after each cluster finishes (when enabled). Receiver guards (deployability+admission+val_return) are logged. _should_migrate_this_round is kept as a legacy helper with docstring noting it's unused in the active scheduler.
risks: The val sampling window will now differ from train (by design), which means backtest results may shift slightly due to different sample regions. This is the intended behavior to reduce train/val regime overlap.
If any external code reads _sample_seed and expects it to control val sampling, it may need updating. All internal paths use _val_sample_seed for val sampling.
